summary: A write to a pinned control asks. A read, and a write to product code, do not.
Cyclomatic ratchet. New functions stay at or under the cap. Named functions may not grow.
The file hook runs the pack scripts. It does not ask the agent to.
The committed pack matches a fresh build, and a changed byte does not.
Question text is an API. Editing v1 instructions fails until the version directory changes.
Every registered path has an eval suite. A case without a verdict does not load.
Pinned tests and quality controls match their recorded hashes.
Import boundaries, read from import statements. Comments and strings do not count.
The mutation run stays pointed at the decision modules and the unit tests that exercise them.
The local profile is the one that runs. The AWS profile is the unused switch.
The stop hook blocks a red suite and stays quiet for a session-end fire.
Tools are manifest names. Agents and workflows do not carry tool functions.
